title: Attendance Activity Launcher Polish
release_notes: Attendance report removes whole-month total, keeps average and highest attendance, and uses Service Breakdown wording.
Attendance report print layout now fits letter bond paper with logo and church information at the top.
Attendance page reloads when the selected date changes so the present count matches that date.
Activity notes can save text-only notes without being blocked by image upload folder checks.
Launcher uses the CMS logo, Please Wait status wording, and blinking traffic lights.
